steps.content: HIGH POPULATION DENSITY. This is a large number of people living in an area compared to the available resources . Page 47 Areas with a High population density. LOW POPULATION DENSITY. This is when an area has a small number of people compared to the available resources . Communicable diseases can not easily spread from one homestead to another. Disadvantages of a low population density. Areas that have a good climate attract a high population density Areas that have fertile soils attract high population density to practice agriculture. Of what importance is a high population to the following Population density : this is the average number of people per square kilometer Population density = total population = number of people per square kilometer Area Population distributions the way people are spread in different areas of the country. OR Population distribution is the differing number of people living in different areas. Population census is the general counting of people in an area. National population census National population census is the general counting of people in a country. It helps the government to know the population structure. Qn. Mention the ministry that carries out national population census
